summary: Verified TT$->USD conversion feature end-to-end. All core requirements pass: storefront shows raw TT$ (8/45/10, delivery TT$15), currency toggle to US$ shows correct converted values (1.18/6.64/1.47), cart shows raw TT$45 (no inflation, cart-grand-subtotal and cart-store-subtotal both TT$45.00), backend converts food orders correctly (subtotal 6.64, delivery 2.21, item 6.64, total 11.85 = 6.64+2.21+3.00 service fee), taxi orders exempt (delivery_fee=6.38 USD, not divided), checkout dual currency renders correctly (currency-primary=TTD 80.34, currency-secondary=USD 11.85, TT$ line items sum). Search sort mostly works but featured search has a minor ordering bug caused by restaurant/business interleaving after per-list sort.

minor.issue: Test-named restaurant 'Notify Test Diner' appears at index 13, before real business 'CarePoint Drugs' at index 14. Restaurants and businesses are each sorted with test-names last individually, but the round-robin interleaving in search_featured (server.py ~line 1281-1290) then intermixes them, causing a test-named restaurant to appear before a real business. Fix: after interleaving, apply a final stable sort pushing _is_test_name items to the end of the combined results.

issues: Duplicate React key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, Popular' - two categories both labelled 'Popular' emit the same key. Non-blocking but should be fixed by keying on category id/index.

action_items: Fix /api/search/featured interleave to preserve test-last ordering across the merged result list.
Fix duplicate 'Popular' React key warning in RestaurantMenu category chips.
critical_code_review_comments: search_featured interleave logic overrides the per-list _is_test_name sort - either sort the final combined array again or add a post-interleave stable pass to push test-named items last.
server.py is 13,696 lines - should be split into modules for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (menu raw TT$, toggle, cart, checkout dual-currency all verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Currency conversion fix works. Only remaining item is featured-search interleave sort. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_currency_ttd.py; run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set.
rca of the issue: search_featured builds two lists (restaurants, businesses), sorts each independently with test-named items last, then interleaves 2 restaurants : 1 business until the cap. Because interleaving occurs after per-list sorting, a test-named restaurant at the tail of the restaurant list can still land before real businesses that appear later in the business list. Mitigation: apply results.sort(key=lambda x: 1 if _is_test_name(x.get('name')) else 0) after the interleave loop.
